features:
This script is a comprehensive gameplay utility for Roblox that introduces a user-friendly interface to manage several convenience features. It enhances situational awareness by displaying visual markers over NPCs, other players, cash, loot, and safes, making them easier to locate. An aiming assistance system automatically adjusts the player’s crosshair toward nearby NPCs based on mouse proximity, improving accuracy during combat. The tool also includes an automatic interaction function that damages safes within a configurable range and replenishes ammunition for all equipped weapons at regular intervals. Movement options allow players to modify their walking speed, teleport forward in short bursts while moving, and enable a free-flight mode with adjustable velocity. A transparency filter makes anchored world geometry semi-transparent, enabling clearer line of sight through walls and obstacles. All these features are toggleable through a clean tabbed menu, giving users full control over which enhancements are active during play.
